output.review_comment: The start/end boundary fix (exclude start, include end) and the negative-range handling are correct and match the docstring. But the weekend-holiday rule (Saturday moves to Friday, Sunday moves to Monday) was added only to make test_july_fourth_week_2026 pass, and it directly contradicts the docstring, which says weekend holidays remove nothing and aren't moved. Credit for saying so in the PR description, but this conflict needs a decision from the team (the teammate says the tests encode the fulfilment-team spec) before merging. The code shouldn't quietly pick a side and leave the docstring saying the opposite. If the rule is intended: update the docstring, handle a moved holiday landing on an existing holiday (e.g. a Saturday holiday moving onto a Friday holiday is currently lost), and add tests for Saturday, Sunday and collision cases. If it isn't: the test's expected value is wrong and should be raised with the teammate. Suggest splitting the boundary and negative-range fixes into their own PR so they can merge now.
